limits: Checks apply to the exact adopted full hierarchical GDS with Magic drc(full) and the pinned KLayout multi-rule deck; no abstract maglef blackboxes or custom flatten patterns are supplied.
KLayout options preserve the pinned PDK defaults: FEOL, BEOL, seal and offgrid enabled, floating_metal set to 0. That deck does not consume the floating_metal option.
No ignored categories, waivers or division of Magic bounding-box counts are applied. Both tools must execute and report zero violations for adoption.
This is the selected open-source deck result, not exhaustive foundry qualification, density closure, LVS or dynamic post-layout verification.
